single_developer_boundary: Changes require hosted checks but no second-person or human-review approval. Repository assessment uses the orchestrated agent panel.
source_observation: GitHub branch-protection API response recorded after applying the configuration.
review_requirement_verification: Use GraphQL branchProtectionRule.requiresApprovingReviews=false and requiredApprovingReviewCount=null, or absence of required_pull_request_reviews in the aggregate REST response. Do not infer enablement from the standalone legacy REST subresource, which can return a default count even when review enforcement is disabled.
